evidence.quote: Systems immunology approaches were employed to investigate innate and adaptive immune responses to influenza and pneumococcal vaccines.

Thus, the innate response, measured within hours in the peripheral blood, was dominated by an interferon transcriptional signature after influenza vaccination and by an inflammation signature after pneumococcal vaccination.
